text:
maya: Quick thought — could we add a tiny 'nudge' action to the deploy bot for late-stage rollouts?
maya: Something that posts a short reminder to the on-call and creates a lightweight rollback ticket if not acknowledged in X minutes.
sam: I like that. What problem are we trying to solve exactly?
maya: Two things: 1) avoid forgotten handoffs during 11pm change windows, 2) reduce noisy full rollbacks for small flappers — nudge first, rollback only after explicit fail or no response.
jonah: So nudge = ping + quick state snapshot + optional auto-ticket. if no ack within e.g. 10m, create ticket but don't roll back automatically.
lina: Could be configurable per-release: nudge-window, ack-window, ticket-template, severity. Keep defaults conservative.
sam: How would the UI/command look? shorthand so release engineers don't type a lot.
maya: Draft commands (very compact) — put these in the thread for feedback:
```
/release nudge start --id <release-id> --ack 10m --ticket on
/release nudge status --id <release-id>
/release nudge stop --id <release-id>
```
maya: The 'start' command posts in the release channel: @oncall please ack, and attaches a tiny JSON snapshot: model version, pinned image digest, active autoscale, change window end.
deploy-bot: I can implement the behavior. Defaults: ack 15m, ticket on, severity P3. Will record events to release-log.
jonah: Nice — add a condensed release-note snippet generation step too: if ack received, bot asks for 1-line release note that gets appended to release notes doc.
lina: +1. That prevents missing short changelog entries for last-minute patches.
sam: We should surface the KV-cache/quantization profile in the snapshot for ML releases (so we know perf knobs).
maya: Good call. Also, make sure the ticket template includes rollback instructions and pin info.
deploy-bot: Example ticket body I propose:
```
Title: [AUTO] Release <id> no-ack followup
Body:
- Release id: <id>
- Started: <ts>
- Snapshot: model=<model>, image=<digest>, kv_cache=<on/off>, q_profile=<name>
- Suggested action: contact owner / rollback to <prev-version> if regressions observed
```
jonah: For safety add an opt-in auto-rollback flag that only kicks in for canaries when failure rate > threshold. Not default.
lina: How about a shorthand to create a 'handoff card' for the next shift? /release nudge handoff --to @name --eta 30m -> creates card in ops board.
sam: Love the handoff card idea. reduces slack threads at 2am.
maya: Implementation checklist: 1) commands & flags 2) ticket template + ops-board integration 3) compact snapshot payload 4) release-note prompt flow 5) canary auto-rollback opt-in 6) tests + dry-run mode
jonah: I can prototype the snapshot payload and ticket body today.
lina: I'll draft the UX text and default timings.
sam: I'll add linting rules for the commands so no ambiguous flags.
maya: ok team — if we agree I'll open a tiny RFC and PR for the deploy-bot command set. Aim for a 2-week small rollout to staging. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created issue RN-4827 (prototype nudge action). Link: https://issues.internal/RN-4827
maya: Perfect — thanks.
